# Oxx Report

> Oxx Report is an AI-assisted reporting tool for engineers, inspectors and consultants. It turns site photos, voice notes and observations into an evidence-linked draft inspection report that the professional reviews, edits and approves. Built in Cape Town, South Africa, and priced in South African rand.

Key facts:

- Workflow: Inspect / Capture, Organise, Ground the Reasoning, Generate Report, Review / Refine.
- Professional review is always required. The engineer checks, approves and takes responsibility for the final report. Oxx Report does not replace professional judgment.
- Pricing (South African rand): R1,000 per delivered report (pay as you use, no subscription), or R500/month for unlimited reports plus token usage of typically about R100 per report.
- Free trial: three free reports, no card required.
- Time saved (example at R1,500/hour): a standard report takes about 4.25 hours, and about 1.25 hours with Oxx Report. That saves about 3 hours and about R4,500 per report, about 70% less time.
- Access: web app at https://report.oxx-ai.com/, installable on phone and desktop. Android app (Android 7.0 or later) to download from https://oxx-ai.com/downloads/. A native iOS app is planned.
- Microsoft Word integration for final editing.
- Founders: James Goodhead and Andrew Goodhead, co-founders.
- Contact: andrew@oxx.co.za, WhatsApp +27 62 036 1649, Cape Town, South Africa.
